propositions: Live-Cloud draft against shared REB + DIG projects surfaced that non-existent project keys raise parse errors in real Jira rather than returning empty, causing inbound fetcher to abort the entire pass due to missing per-project exception handling.

Ephemeral Jira DC instance with admin-provisionable throwaway projects enables modeling of three repo configurations, empty projects, and unknown-project fail-closed behavior without constraining shared production projects.

Multi-project rehearsal scenarios must be preview-gated via dry-run to assert mutating operations target only their intended project with empty intersection against all other configured projects before sync execution.

Scratch projects provisioned per run with random RBJ-prefixed keys are torn down on all exit paths including mid-scenario failures, with session guards preventing leftover project leakage between runs.
